title: GitHub Stats and Most Used Languages
purpose: Explain how the GitHub statistics and language-usage cards are generated and displayed.

files.update_stats.py: Python generator that reads GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs and writes four theme-specific SVG cards into this folder.
files.github-stats-dark.svg: Main GitHub statistics card for dark theme.
files.github-stats-light.svg: Main GitHub statistics card for light theme.
files.github-top-langs-dark.svg: Most Used Languages card for dark theme; language-specific colors are retained.
files.github-top-langs-light.svg: Most Used Languages card for light theme; language-specific colors are retained.

generation.automatic: GitHub Actions runs daily at 00:00 UTC (08:00 WITA).
generation.manual: Open the repository Actions tab, select Update GitHub Stats, and choose Run workflow.
requirements: The GitHub Environment named GH_STATS_TOKEN must contain an Environment secret named GH_STATS_TOKEN.
The token must be able to read the repositories and contribution data intended for inclusion.
The workflow uses the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN with contents: write to commit updated SVG files.

usage.readme: Use an HTML picture element with dark and light source paths so GitHub can choose the matching theme.

metrics.stars: Sum of stars on accessible repositories owned by the account.
metrics.contributions: GitHub contribution-calendar totals summed by calendar year starting in 2008.
metrics.commits: Distinct commits attributed to the account on owned repositories' default branches.
metrics.issues: GitHub-recognized issue contributions summed by calendar year.
metrics.repositoriesContributedTo: Repositories returned by GitHub's repositoriesContributedTo connection.
metrics.languages: Top six languages aggregated by GitHub-reported language bytes across accessible owned repositories.

notes: Only four theme-specific SVG files are generated; legacy theme-unspecified SVG files are not generated.
GitHub Actions workflow definitions must stay in .github/workflows for GitHub to discover them.
This generator does not deploy to Vercel.
